legalFacts.licenseNote: Normal beach angling requires a sport fishing license for ages 16+, apart from applicable statutory exemptions; a nearby public pier does not extend its exemption onto the beach.

accessReview.inventoryMeaning: Listed public beach approaches, not confirmed real-time opening status. Blank closure fields do not establish that all closures are absent.

ownerFacts.fact: Day-use beach access and parking; dawn to dusk. Resting seals may occupy the shoreline. Pier-only licensing exemption does not apply on the beach.
Beach fishing is listed; stay out of posted sensitive habitat. Dogs prohibited on beach.
